objective: Assess the cyberalchemy-orchestrator repository and recommend the single next bounded capability that creates the greatest reusable construction leverage.

issuing_user_evidence.confirmation: Pode invocar subagentes para te ajudar a decidir isso, scouts, um fan-out pelo repo, o que voce achar necessário. Nao precisa confirmar comigo
issuing_user_evidence.context: The user explicitly delegated selection and launch of a bounded repository fan-out for this prioritization assessment without another conversational confirmation.

path_constraints: Denied paths override every allowed path and may not be changed by a delegated dispatch.
Preserve unrelated and pre-existing worktree changes.
Telemetry paths may be mutated only by repository lifecycle hooks or the existing governed appender.
tool_constraints: functions.shell_command is limited to read-only repository inspection and non-mutating validation.
collaboration tools are limited to the exact read-only proposal contained by this envelope.
required_controls: Exact proposal and envelope digests are bound before launch.
One capability review and two independent check-tension PASS verdicts are required.
Two independent read-only envelope auditors must PASS total containment.
All Agent/spawn_agent lifecycle hooks remain enabled and must return launch-authorized.
The research dispatch uses the LIVE research skill and receives parent final approval.
Every recommendation names evidence, dependency unlocks, time-to-value, risk, and a falsifiable first slice.
forbidden_effects: git commit, push, branch rewrite, reset, or destructive cleanup
credential, secret, permission, billing, or account changes
external messages, publications, uploads, or writes
disabling, bypassing, or weakening lifecycle enforcement
silently resolving a product or authority decision beyond producing a recommendation
stop_conditions: The recommendation and evidence comparison are complete.
Any required control fails or cannot produce durable evidence.
Safe read-only isolation from concurrent worktree changes is impossible.
The user revokes or replaces this envelope.
human_reconfirmation_required_when: Any repository, dispatch type, tool, network class, mutation, output, or effect is outside this envelope.
Implementation, authenticated access, deployment, destructive action, git publication, or external write becomes necessary.
An auditor reports ambiguity, mismatch, or incomplete containment.
final_approver_policy: The primary orchestrator synthesizes and approves the read-only recommendation; implementation remains a separate decision.
